result.instructions: Tools for Jumbula, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which families still owe an installment this month?"; "Find the order for jane.doe@example.com and show its registration form."; "How many registrations does our summer camp have this season?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Jumbula data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jumbula_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jumbula_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jumbula_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. jumbula_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jumbula_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search registration orders by season, program, status, family name, email, confirmation id or date range. Returns order details. Filters are optional. Jumbula: POST /v2/orders (a read-only search).

status.description: Order status filter, as Jumbula names it.

name.description: Matches the first name, last name, or both.

registrationDateRange.description: Registration date range, as the Jumbula API expects it.

modifiedDateRange.description: Last-modified date range, as the Jumbula API expects it.

include.description: Nested data to include, as Jumbula names it (for example form or installment).

tools.name: jumbula_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id. Use include to add nested data such as the form or installments. Jumbula: GET /v2/orders/{id}.

orderId.description: The id, as returned by another Jumbula tool.

include.description: Nested data to include (for example form), as Jumbula names it.

tools.name: jumbula_get_order_forms
tools.title: Get an order's forms
tools.description: Get the registration form answers for one order. Jumbula: GET /v2/orders/Form-By-OrderId?orderId=.

orderId.description: The id, as returned by another Jumbula tool.

tools.name: jumbula_get_order_waiver
tools.title: Get a waiver
tools.description: Get one signed waiver (legal agreement) by its id. Jumbula: GET /v2/orders/waiver/{id}.

waiverId.description: The id, as returned by another Jumbula tool.

tools.name: jumbula_list_order_transactions
tools.title: List payment transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions for orders, with amount, date and status. Use it to check payments or investigate a disputed charge. Jumbula: GET /v2/orders/transaction.

status.description: Transaction status filter, as Jumbula names it.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method filter, as Jumbula names it.

tools.name: jumbula_list_installments
tools.title: List installments
tools.description: List payment installments for orders: due dates, amounts, status and payment errors. Use it to find overdue or failed installments. Jumbula: GET /v2/orders/installment.

status.description: Installment status filter, as Jumbula names it.

orderStatus.description: Order status filter, as Jumbula names it.

tools.name: jumbula_search_families
tools.title: Search families
tools.description: Search family accounts by parent email, phone, participant name, external id or business. Returns the matching families. Jumbula: POST /v1/Family/GetAllFamily (a read-only search).

externalId.description: The family's external id (from another system).

tools.name: jumbula_get_family
tools.title: Get a family
tools.description: Get one family account by id, with its contact details and linked records. Jumbula: GET /v1/Family/{id}.

familyId.description: The id, as returned by another Jumbula tool.

tools.name: jumbula_list_family_participants
tools.title: List a family's participants
tools.description: List the participants (children or students) in one family. Jumbula: GET /v1/Family/{familyId}/participants.

familyId.description: The id, as returned by another Jumbula tool.

tools.name: jumbula_list_family_parents
tools.title: List a family's parents
tools.description: List the parents and guardians in one family. Jumbula: GET /v1/Family/{familyId}/Parents.

familyId.description: The id, as returned by another Jumbula tool.

tools.name: jumbula_create_coupon
tools.title: Create a coupon
tools.description: Create a discount coupon code that families enter at checkout. This is a live change: it can cut real prices. Jumbula: POST /v1/Coupon.

code.description: Unique code families enter at checkout.

amount.description: Whole-number discount value: a percent or a fixed amount, set by amountType.

startDate.description: Activation date, as the Jumbula API expects it (for example 2026-12-01).

endDate.description: Expiry date, as the Jumbula API expects it (for example 2026-12-31).

seasonId.description: Season id the coupon applies to.

applyToAllInstallments.description: Apply the discount to every installment.

selectedProgramIds.description: Program ids, when not all programs.

appliesTo.description: Target: all_schedule, least_expensive_schedule, most_expensive_schedule, least_expensive_order or most_expensive_order.

calculateType.description: Calculation mode, for example only_tuition, only_extra_services or total_amount.

isPerFamily.description: Limit usage to once per family.

maximumNumberOfUse.description: Maximum number of uses, as a string.

tools.name: jumbula_update_coupon
tools.title: Update a coupon
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on an existing coupon. Fields you leave out stay as they are. This is a live change to a discount in use. Jumbula: PUT /v1/Coupon/{id}.

couponId.description: The coupon id, as returned when it was created.

startDate.description: New activation date, as the Jumbula API expects it.

endDate.description: New expiry date, as the Jumbula API expects it.

seasonId.description: Season id the coupon applies to.

applyToAllInstallments.description: Apply the discount to every installment.

selectedProgramIds.description: Program ids, when not all programs.

appliesTo.description: Target: all_schedule, least_expensive_schedule, most_expensive_schedule, least_expensive_order or most_expensive_order.

calculateType.description: Calculation mode, for example only_tuition, only_extra_services or total_amount.

isPerFamily.description: Limit usage to once per family.

maximumNumberOfUse.description: Maximum number of uses, as a string.
